data.body: PLAN DEFECT confirmed by completion verification and source/tests: the absolute phrase "rebar fsck is clean" is incompatible with the existing store baseline and fsck contract. `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED` is intentional permanent audit evidence (`fsck.py` increments issue_count; integration tests require it in structured issues), so literal zero would require deleting audit history or changing an unrelated public diagnostic contract. The scoped causal proof that this deletion introduced no corruption is equality of the complete before/after diagnostic multiset plus a green post-delete reconcile-check. Revising that one criterion accordingly and re-running signed plan review; not force-closing and not deleting evidence.
